about_the_game:
Game Demo Description: The First 7 Days

You awaken in a monster's cage, your memory completely wiped clean. All you know is that a death countdown has started.

This Demo introduces you to the story's critical first 7 days. You will immediately confront four distinct "Cell-Mates". Your goal is to make a pivotal moral choice through dialogue and exploration before chaos fully erupts, securing the initial clues needed for escape.

 Demo Content & Features (Days 1–7)

The Demo includes the entire opening segment of the game, focusing on establishing relationships and the central conflict:

  • Time Trial Challenge: Experience the game's crucial first 7 days, immediately feeling the pressure of the countdown.

  • Initial Relationships: Dive deep and get to know the five main characters (Wang Lie, Zhou Yan, Lin Ziqing, Shang Ji, Gu Chunjing), discovering their initial motivations and hidden secrets.

  • Branching Choices: Your decisions will determine whether you commit to trusting your companions or embark on a solitary path of exploration.

  • Unlock Key Clues: Your efforts will unlock the initial clues regarding the Labyrinth Exit, though the final puzzle solution will only be found in the full version.

  • Please Note: The Demo does not unlock the final escape ending. The full escape and the characters' complete fates will be revealed in the full game.

Core Gameplay (Consistent with the Full Game)

  • Visual Narrative Experience: A story-driven horror puzzle game.

  • Choices Impact Progress: Your dialogue and exploration choices influence the narrative direction.

  • The Start of Multiple Endings: Your initial decisions lay the groundwork for the full game's multiple story conclusions.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains themes and content that may be disturbing or triggering for some players. Player discretion is advised.

1. Violence, Gore, and Body Horror
Mutilation and Body Horror, Death and Post-Mortem Imagery, Non-Voluntary Violence.

2. Mature Psychological Themes
Suicide and Self-Harm, Extreme Mental Manipulation, Cruel Moral Dilemmas, Implied Fetishization/Non-Traditional Attachment.

Note: This game does not contain any direct sexual acts or sexual violence.

I advise that players sensitive to themes of self-harm, psychological control, or body modification carefully consider their purchase.
